meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For acne-prone skin in India under ₹700, the best serums typically feature **Salicylic Acid** (to clear active breakouts and unclog pores) or **Niacinamide** (to control excess oil and fade post-acne marks).[thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/products/sali-cinamide-anti-acne-serum-with-2-salicylic-acid-5-niacinamide-30ml#:~:text=How%20does%20the%20Sali-Cinamide%20Serum%20fight%20acne%3F,and%20toned%20face%2C%20gently%20massaging%20until%20absorbed.)

Top options available within your budget include:

The Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum targets **blackheads, whiteheads, and active acne** using deep pore-clearing exfoliants.

The Dot & Key 2% Salicylic Cica Anti Acne Serum combines salicylic acid with **soothing cica and cactus water** to calm irritation while fighting breakouts.

The The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% utilizes a high-strength formula to **regulate sebum production** and minimize the look of enlarged pores.

The Plum 10% Niacinamide Brightening Face Serum Rice Water pairs niacinamide with rice ferment to **fade stubborn acne marks** and improve overall skin texture.
